title: Swap the brain, keep the conscience.
hook: We can swap the model without transplanting our conscience.
thesis: TenantOS is the operating layer above interchangeable runtimes: Codex, Claude, local models, remote workers, MCP tools. The model is a hand; authority is the skeleton. Change models without changing authority, add local inference without changing evidence, add runtimes without moving owner decisions. This post explains runtime optionality without inventing any new model claims.

verified: TenantOS is the operating contract for many runtimes with none of them becoming canonical truth (TENANTOS-HARVEST-ORDER.md, via SYSTEMS.md section 3).
External runtimes may own their process and session; they must never own tenant identity, authorization truth, or outcome truth (harvest order, via SYSTEMS.md section 3).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
